scope: Actual iPhone Simulator native external File Provider delivery over loopback, Taskfold restore/keep-current-work and cold relaunch. No iCloud/Dropbox/production-cloud or universal provider compatibility claim.
pipeline: Native fixture host registers its own public nonreplicated provider and publishes fresh file identities
Real Files controls enable only the synthetic provider location
Taskfold’s existing UIDocumentPickerViewController, asCopy:false, selects its external file
Provider startProvidingItem fetches bundled synthetic JSON from loopback server; no result/read/preview injection
Normal BackupFileReadOperation coordinates the downloaded file and normal restore preview applies it
Cold relaunch exposes the added task, description, 25-minute estimate, 25 Oct deadline and unchanged newer current task

beforeRestoreRecoveryCopy.scope: Existing encrypted-vault index in the isolated app; no decrypted-content or new history-UI claim.

signatures.clientScope: Strict real-team app/widget/runner/test signatures and linked Simulator identity/group verified before unchanged final client runs. This is development testing, not distribution acceptance.

fixtureCorrection.cause: Nonreplicated domain declared pathRelativeToDocumentStorage=synthetic, but prototypes mapped item URLs from its parent directory. This can list items without reliable content routing. Corrected using the SDK-declared domain-relative directory.
fixtureCorrection.source: Apple iPhoneSimulator SDK FileProvider.framework Headers/NSFileProviderDomain.h and NSFileProviderManager.h
fixtureCorrection.staleCacheHandling: Publish a fresh generation of file IDs with real delete/update enumeration notifications. Never count a cached read as a new transfer.

failedDiagnosticsRetained.boundary: Restore/relaunch saved both records correctly; a title-only static-text lookup did not find the combined current-task accessibility row.
An added immediate recovery-history UI-count assertion failed; no lost safety copy is inferred. Final on-disk history separately contains Before restore for one record.
The restored row accessibility label also contains description/deadline/estimate; an exact title-only equality check was invalid.
All restore/relaunch UI checks passed, but a new-transfer assertion detected a cached-file read with no new network request.
Deleting cached fixture bytes left stale metadata; preview failed with actionable file-unavailable guidance and no new network delivery.
Fresh item identities were visible, but the fixture still mapped URLs outside its declared domain directory. No new content delivery; preview failed safely.

ownership: Reusable provider/server/installer and native driver are owned only by TaskFold-iOS. No shipping target depends on TestSupport or on the Mac repo. Mac keeps its already separate real iCloud transfer acceptance.

cleanup.earlierReplicatedDisposableDeviceResidua: Prior Simulator-delete Cocoa 513/POSIX 1 residual remains stopped; no new permission override or delete retry.

remaining: Actual unavailable/offline-file recovery and retry through this provider

System-selected widget privacy, remaining representative installed Mac interactions and user-deferred spoken accessibility/signing retain their existing scope
